The WorldTick issue is that when `new WorldTick(ws)` is called in ServerBootstrap, it's not passing all the required dependencies (persistence, playerSystem, npcSystem, etc.).

This appears to be a design issue - the WorldTick constructor takes 15+ dependencies, but ServerBootstrap line 393 only passes `ws`:

```typescript
const tick = new WorldTick(ws);
```

This means there's expected to be some dependency injection or factory that creates WorldTick with all its dependencies automatically. But the code at line 393 just passes ws.

This could work if there's some factory or some defaults being set. Let me check around line 393 to see what's passed - maybe there should be more arguments.

Actually wait - there could be a default factory, or the code could have been changed at some point. Let me see if line 393 in the original codebase has more arguments or if there's some wrapper.

Let me fix this by passing undefined/null for the missing dependencies - the init() method could check for undefined.
